summary: This note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on Minsk Region, one of the regions (voblasts) of Belarus. It notes that the region's administrative center is Minsk, which is nonetheless treated as a separate administrative territorial entity. It gives the region's population as of 2011.
one_line: Minsk Region (Minsk Voblasć), a Belarusian region whose administrative center is Minsk, had about 1.41 million residents in 2011.
key_facts: Minsk Region is also known as Minsk Voblasć or Minsk Oblast.
Minsk Region is one of the regions of Belarus.
The administrative center of Minsk Region is Minsk.
Minsk is a separate administrative territorial entity of Belarus, distinct from Minsk Region.
As of 2011, the population of Minsk Region is 1,411,500.
